description: Westside Credit Union runs the same CoreUnion servicing product with a local compliance interstitial and a relabelled search control. The base recording is reused; only those two deltas are patched.

target.description: Continue button on the tenant compliance notice
target.robustness: The notice is a tenant-specific interstitial; the control is identified by the operator-facing label, not by markup.

step.intent: Dismiss Westside's local compliance notice so the workspace is usable.

target.description: Find Member button (Westside label for the same search control)
target.robustness: Westside rebrands the control; the fallback to the vendor label absorbs a revert.
